label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The Export button stays greyed out after a failed export because the 'busy' state is set to true when the export starts but is only set back to false on a successful export (in the .then() handler). If the exportReport promise rejects (export fails), 'busy' remains true, keeping the button disabled. The code needs to handle the rejection case by resetting 'busy' to false and showing an error toast to allow retrying the export.
